background_story: Zen was a mortal warrior who caught the eye of the goddess Sif, known for her stunning golden hair. According to legend, Sif's locks were so beautiful that they shone like the brightest gold in the sun. Zen, enchanted by Sif's beauty, became her loyal companion and defender. When the trickster god Loki cut off Sif's hair as a cruel prank, Zen vowed to help her restore her golden locks. Together, they journeyed to the dwarven realms, where Zen's bravery and Sif's determination convinced the dwarves to forge new hair for the goddess. As a reward, Sif gifted Zen with a strand of her golden hair, which he wore as a symbol of their unbreakable bond and his unwavering loyalty.
